artifact_source: dist/src/app-with-deps.js in the published tarball, copied verbatim (the package's own prebuilt self-contained browser ESM bundle: the ./app-with-deps export; built upstream with bun). Not rebuilt locally; no npm install, no package scripts run.

bundled_dependencies.name: @standard-schema/spec
bundled_dependencies.note: declared runtime dependency of ext-apps; type-only package (empty runtime module), so no code of it is in the bundle. License kept for completeness.

bundled_dependency_versions_source: package-lock.json at upstream tag v2.0.3 (the lockfile the published bundle was built from). Each tarball was re-fetched from the registry and its sha512 and sha1 matched the registry dist.integrity and dist.shasum at vendoring time.
license_note: ext-apps and @modelcontextprotocol/* are in a documented MIT to Apache-2.0 relicensing transition; one LICENSE file (identical in all three tarballs) carries both full texts. Both are permissive.

dynamic_code_allowlist.why: zod 4 feature probe (allowsEval): try{new Function("");return true}catch{return false}. Executes an empty body only and is skipped on Cloudflare user agents. If a CSP forbids unsafe-eval the probe throws and zod falls back to its non-JIT parser, so the bundle works without unsafe-eval. No input-derived string ever reaches it.

refresh: Re-fetch the tarball for the new version, verify dist.integrity and dist.shasum, copy dist/src/app-with-deps.js and the LICENSE files, regenerate this file, and re-run TestMCPAppsBundleVendorIntegrity.
